# Stormglass Io

stormglass.io provides a global weather API offering high-resolution forecasts and historical data from trusted meteorological institutions.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/stormglass-io/.

## Actions

- **Get Elevation for Point** (read-only): Fetch elevation data for a single geographic point.
- **Get solar data for a point** (read-only): Fetch solar irradiation and sun-position data for a specific coordinate.
- **Get weather data for a point** (read-only): Fetch marine and land weather data for a specific coordinate.
- **List All Tide Stations** (read-only): List all available tide stations.
